articles.title: 'Steps' Retells Cinderella From the Stepsisters' Side
articles.summary: Netflix's 'Steps' retells Cinderella through stepsisters Lilith and Margot — funny and brightly colored, but with a crowded story, according to the review.

articles.title: RAYE Leads the 2027 Grammy Nominations With 11
articles.summary: RAYE leads the 2027 Grammy nominations with 11, tying a record, while Rosalía follows with nine; the winners will be announced on February 7, 2027.

articles.title: This Drone Perches Like a Bird — Using Touch
articles.summary: A Delft University drone with three finger-like grippers can feel its way onto a branch and hang there without using extra energy.
